# Xiaohongshu (6 endpoints)

## Endpoints

| Resource | Params | Credits | Description |
|----------|--------|---------|-------------|
| /search | `query` | **5-100** | Search Xiaohongshu notes |
| /trending | `limit`? | **5-100** | Get the Xiaohongshu hot search board |
| /profile | `url` / `id` | 5 | Get a Xiaohongshu creator |
| /profile/posts | `url` / `id` | **5-100** | List a Xiaohongshu creator's notes |
| /post | `url` | 5 | Get a Xiaohongshu note |
| /post/comments | `url` | **5-100** | Get Xiaohongshu note comments |

### Parameter legend

- `a`, `b` — both required.
- `a` / `b` — a `oneOf` group: at least one member must be provided.
- `a`? — the spec marks nothing required, but these are the parameters the endpoint accepts;
  a bare call usually will not work. See Endpoint Details for which combination to send.
- *(none)* — takes no parameters at all.
- A method prefix (**POST**, **DELETE**, **PATCH**) marks a non-GET endpoint; unmarked rows are GET.
- Every endpoint also accepts the `Cache-Control` header (send `no-cache` to bypass the
  response cache — billed at the normal rate) and `Idempotency-Key` (a UUID that makes a
  retry safe; a replay returns the cached payload without double-billing).

## Endpoint Details

_What each endpoint returns and when to reach for it._

### /search — 5-100cr

Returns Xiaohongshu notes matching a keyword. Each row has a title, a short summary in post.content.text (post.ext.text_truncated is true; the full body is on GET /v1/xiaohongshu/post), the creator, likes, comments, saves, shares and a cover image. Xiaohongshu does not publish view counts, so post.engagement.views is null. Pass the returned cursor to read the next page.

> ⚠️ **Metered: 5-100 credits a call — budget the 100 ceiling, not the low end.** Vendor label: 5-100 (metered): 5 credits per row RETURNED. The call holds `limit x 5` up front and settles down to the rows actually delivered.

**Parameters**

- `query`: Search keywords, for example 护肤 or camping.
- `limit` *(optional)*: Rows to return, 1 to 20. Default 10. Each row costs 5 credits and you are charged only for rows returned.
- `cursor` *(optional)*: Continuation token from a previous response's pagination block. Omit for the first page.
- `sort` *(optional)*: Result ordering: relevance, latest, most_liked, most_commented, or most_collected. Default relevance.
- `type` *(optional)*: Note type: all, image, or video. Default all.
- `published` *(optional)*: Recency window: all, day, week, or half_year. Default all.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/xiaohongshu/search?query=<query>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /trending — 5-100cr

Returns the live Xiaohongshu hot search board: ranked topics with a hot value. There is no next page. A lower limit returns the top of the same board, and you are charged for the topics returned.

> ⚠️ **Metered: 5-100 credits a call — budget the 100 ceiling, not the low end.** Vendor label: 5-100 (metered): 5 credits per row RETURNED. The call holds `limit x 5` up front and settles down to the rows actually delivered.

**Parameters**

- `limit` *(optional)*: Topics to return, 1 to 20. Default 10. Each topic costs 5 credits and you are charged only for topics returned.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/xiaohongshu/trending" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /profile — 5cr

Returns one Xiaohongshu creator: display name, RedNote id (author.username), bio, avatar, followers, following, notes posted, likes received and the IP province. Accepts a profile URL or the user id carried on a note as post.ext.author_id. The RedNote id is not a lookup key. For the creator's notes call GET /v1/xiaohongshu/profile/posts.

**Parameters**

- `url` / `id` — at least one required.
  - `url`: Xiaohongshu profile URL, for example https://www.xiaohongshu.com/user/profile/6a59f257000000000f03b000. (one of: url, id; at least one required)
  - `id`: User id, the author_user_id on a note. Not the RedNote id. (one of: url, id; at least one required)

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/xiaohongshu/profile?url=<url>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /profile/posts — 5-100cr

Returns a Xiaohongshu creator's notes, newest first. Each row has a title, a short summary (post.ext.text_truncated is true) and engagement counts. Pinned notes set post.flags.pinned. Pass the returned cursor to read further. Xiaohongshu does not publish view counts, so post.engagement.views is null.

> ⚠️ **Metered: 5-100 credits a call — budget the 100 ceiling, not the low end.** Vendor label: 5-100 (metered): 5 credits per row RETURNED. The call holds `limit x 5` up front and settles down to the rows actually delivered.

**Parameters**

- `limit` *(optional)*: Rows to return, 1 to 20. Default 10. Each row costs 5 credits and you are charged only for rows returned.
- `cursor` *(optional)*: Continuation token from a previous response's pagination block. Omit for the first page.
- `url` / `id` — at least one required.
  - `url`: Xiaohongshu profile URL. (one of: url, id; at least one required)
  - `id`: User id, the author_user_id on a note. Not the RedNote id. (one of: url, id; at least one required)

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/xiaohongshu/profile/posts?url=<url>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /post — 5cr

Returns one Xiaohongshu note from its URL or note id: full body, images or video, creator, likes, comments, saves, shares and the IP province. post.ext.text_truncated is false. Search rows are only a summary. Xiaohongshu does not publish view counts, so post.engagement.views is null.

**Parameters**

- `url`: Note URL, for example https://www.xiaohongshu.com/explore/6aac8143000000002a007389, or the bare note id.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/xiaohongshu/post?url=<url>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /post/comments — 5-100cr

Returns top level comments on a Xiaohongshu note: text, commenter, likes, reply count, pin flag and the commenter's IP province. Reply threads are not expanded on this call. Pass the returned cursor to read the next page.

> ⚠️ **Metered: 5-100 credits a call — budget the 100 ceiling, not the low end.** Vendor label: 5-100 (metered): 5 credits per row RETURNED. The call holds `limit x 5` up front and settles down to the rows actually delivered.

**Parameters**

- `url`: Note URL or the bare note id the comments sit under.
- `limit` *(optional)*: Rows to return, 1 to 20. Default 10. Each row costs 5 credits and you are charged only for rows returned.
- `cursor` *(optional)*: Continuation token from a previous response's pagination block. Omit for the first page.
- `sort` *(optional)*: Comment ordering: relevance, latest, or most_liked. Default relevance.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/xiaohongshu/post/comments?url=<url>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
